69683-men-without-women.title: Men Without Women
69683-men-without-women.creator: Ernest Hemingway
69683-men-without-women.description: A book by Ernest Hemingway. Manuel looked up at the stuffed bull. He had seen it often before. He felt a certain family interest in it. It had killed his brother, the promising one, about nine years ago. Manuel remembered the day. There was a brass plate on the oak shield the bull’s head was mounted on. Manuel could not read it, but he imagined it was in memory of his brother. Well, he had been a good kid.

arxiv-1911-03781.title: Search for new neutral Higgs bosons through the \PH → \PZ ​ \PSA → ℓ + ​ ℓ − ​ \bbbar \PH\to\PZ\PSA\to\ell^{+}\ell^{-}\bbbar process in \Pp ​ \Pp \Pp\Pp collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-1911-03781.description: Abstract This paper reports on a search for an extension to the scalar sector of the standard model, where a new CP-even (odd) boson decays to a \PZ boson and a lighter CP-odd (even) boson, and the latter further decays to a \cPqb quark pair. The \PZ boson is reconstructed via its decays to electron or muon pairs.

arxiv-2205-05975.title: CorAl: Introspection for Robust Radar and Lidar Perception in Diverse Environments Using Differential Entropy
arxiv-2205-05975.creator: Daniel Adolfsson, Manuel Castellano-Quero, Martin Magnusson, Achim J. Lilienthal, Henrik Andreasson
arxiv-2205-05975.description: Abstract Robust perception is an essential component to enable long-term operation of mobile robots. It depends on failure resilience through reliable sensor data and pre-processing, as well as failure awareness through introspection, for example the abaility to self-assess localization performance.

arxiv-2305-18091.title: Quantum 3.0 : Quantum Learning, Quantum Heuristics and Beyond
arxiv-2305-18091.creator: Mrittunjoy Guha Majumdar
arxiv-2305-18091.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mrittunjoy Guha Majumdar. Quantum learning paradigms address the question of how best to harness conceptual elements of quantum mechanics and information processing to improve operability and functionality of a computing system for specific tasks through experience. It is one of the fastest evolving framework, which lies at the intersection of physics, statistics and information processing, and is the next frontier for data sciences, machine learning and artificial intelligence.

arxiv-2308-04172.title: Predicting Drug-Drug Interactions Using Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2308-04172.creator: Lizzy Farrugia, Lilian M. Azzopardi, Jeremy Debattista, Charlie Abela
arxiv-2308-04172.description: Abstract In the last decades, people have been consuming and combining more drugs than before, increasing the number of Drug-Drug Interactions (DDIs). To predict unknown DDIs, recently, studies started incorporating Knowledge Graphs (KGs) since they are able to capture the relationships among entities providing better drug representations than using a single drug property.

arxiv-2312-01530.title: Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Methods for Time-varying Feature Settings
arxiv-2312-01530.creator:
ame Henrik von Kleist \email henrik.vonkleist@helmholtz-munich.de, 
ame Alireza Zamanian \email alireza.zamanian@iks.fraunhofer.de, 
ame Ilya Shpitser \email ishpits1@jhu.edu, 
ame Narges Ahmidi \email narges.ahmidi@helmholtz-munich.de
arxiv-2312-01530.description: Abstract Machine learning methods often assume that input features are available at no cost. However, in domains like healthcare, where acquiring features could be expensive or harmful, it is necessary to balance a feature’s acquisition cost against its predictive value. The task of training an AI agent to decide which features to acquire is called active feature acquisition (AFA).

arxiv-2401-10401.title: Thermonuclear explosions as Type II supernovae
arxiv-2401-10401.creator: Alexandra Kozyreva, Javier Morán-Fraile, Alexander Holas, Vincent A. Bronner, Friedrich K. Röpke, Nikolay Pavlyuk, Alexey Mironov, Dmitry Tsvetkov
arxiv-2401-10401.description: Abstract We consider a binary stellar system, in which a low-mass, of 0.6 M ⊙ \mathrm{M}_{\odot} , carbon-oxygen white dwarf (WD) mergers with a degenerate helium core of 0.4 M ⊙ \mathrm{M}_{\odot} of a red giant. We analyse the outcome of a merger within a common envelope (CE). We predict the observational properties of the resulting transient.

arxiv-2403-20260.title: Prototype-based Interpretable Breast Cancer Prediction Models: Analysis and Challenges
arxiv-2403-20260.creator: Shreyasi Pathak, Jörg Schlötterer, Jeroen Veltman, Jeroen Geerdink, Maurice van Keulen, Christin Seifert
arxiv-2403-20260.description: Abstract Deep learning models have achieved high performance in medical applications, however, their adoption in clinical practice is hindered due to their black-box nature. Using explainable AI (XAI) in high-stake medical decisions could increase their usability in clinical settings. Self-explainable models, like prototype-based models, can be especially beneficial as they are interpretable by design.

arxiv-2505-01136.title: Descriptor: C++ Self-Admitted Technical Debt Dataset (CppSATD)
arxiv-2505-01136.creator: Phuoc Pham 1 , Murali Sridharan 1 , Matteo Esposito 1 , and Valentina Lenarduzzi 1
arxiv-2505-01136.description: Abstract In software development, technical debt (TD) refers to suboptimal implementation choices made by the developers to meet urgent deadlines and limited resources, posing challenges for future maintenance. Self-Admitted Technical Debt (SATD) is a sub-type of TD, representing specific TD instances “openly admitted” by the developers and often expressed through source code comments.

pmc-10641260.title: Fibromodulin overexpression drives oral squamous cell carcinoma via activating downstream EGFR signaling
pmc-10641260.creator: Lingyun Xia, Tianshu Zhang, Juncheng Yao, Kaitian Lu, Ziqiu Hu, Xinsheng Gu, Yongji Chen, Shanshan Qin, Weidong Leng
pmc-10641260.description: SummaryAccumulating evidence has shown that fibromodulin (FMOD) plays a pivotal role in tumorigenesis and metastasis. However, the biological function of FMOD in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) remains largely unclear to date. In this study, we confirmed that FMOD was overexpressed and showed a significant association with malignant progression and lymph node metastasis in OSCC.

pmc-10646452.creator: Niki Teunissen, Marie Fan, Michael J. Roast, Nataly Hidalgo Aranzamendi, Sjouke A. Kingma, Anne Peters

pmc-12118175.title: The clinical condition rather than cerebrospinal fluid levels may guide the optimal duration of antimicrobial therapy among neonates with bacterial meningitis: A single‐center retrospective study
pmc-12118175.creator: Ya Hu, Xingyuan Li, Hong Wei, Yuanyuan Luo, Hongdong Li
pmc-12118175.description: Neonatal bacterial meningitis is serious and accounts for high morbidity and mortality in developing countries, but the duration of antimicrobial treatment is not well established. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) levels are important factors for diagnosing and monitoring the occurrence and development of bacterial meningitis.

pmc-12664991.title: Healing of a fracture with a significant bone gap in a supradiacondylar fracture of the distal femur treated with dual plating assisted by the use of Nanostructured Hydroxyapatite (NanoBone®) and Hydroxyapatite and Tricalcium Phosphate Blocks (TRIHA+®): Case report
pmc-12664991.creator: Francesco Maria Milella, Giovanni Longo, Massimiliano Paolocci, Emanuele Persi, Riccardo Mezzoprete
pmc-12664991.description: Distal femur fractures present a surgical challenge due to high rates of varus collapse, nonunion, and delayed healing. In cases of severe bone loss, achieving stable fixation while promoting osteogenesis remains critical. The combination of dual plating with advanced bone substitutes may improve outcomes in complex supracondylar fractures.

pmc-12701849.title: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography as a diagnostic key tool for biliary atresia: feasibility, safety and accuracy in neonates with cholestatic liver disease
pmc-12701849.creator: Steffen Hartleif, Michael Esser, Jörg Fuchs, Martin Götz, Florian Graepler, Johannes Hilberath, Toni Illhardt, Hans-Joachim Kirschner, Nisar P Malek, Andreas Manger, Jürgen Schäfer, Ulrike Schempf, Stephan Singer, Christoph Slavetinsky, Dietmar Stüker, Ilias Tsiflikas, Dörte Wichmann, Ekkehard Sturm
pmc-12701849.description: Biliary atresia (BA) is a rare condition in newborns characterised by inflammation and obliteration of bile ducts, leading to cirrhosis. Early diagnosis and treatment through Kasai portoenterostomy are crucial for native liver survival. While diagnostic methods include clinical assessment, laboratory tests and imaging, no non-invasive test can definitively rule out BA.

pmc-13182007.title: An account of health systems resilience to emergencies in Africa: a scoping review
pmc-13182007.creator: Martin Ankomah, Gordon Abekah-Nkrumah, Grace Adjei Okai, Lily Yarney, Anita Asiwome Adzo Baku
pmc-13182007.description: BackgroundHealthcare systems across Africa continue to face a wide range of shocks. Using Ebola and COVID-19 as case studies, this study examines the various resilience strategies implemented in different countries and synthesises them in a way that can serve as a practical guide to make health systems in Africa more resilient for future emergencies.

pmc-13669360.title: Multi-omics profiling identifies triciribine as a biomarker-guided antimetabolite therapy for acute lymphoblastic leukemia
pmc-13669360.creator: Xuekang Qi, Georgios Mermelekas, Ondrej Hodek, Luay Aswad, Quentin Glaziou, Isabelle Rose Leo, Nona Struyf, Femke M Hormann, Ioannis Siavelis, Henri Colyn Bwanika, Owen F J Hovey, Martin Haraldsson, Sean G Rudd, Annika I Johansson, Tom Erkers, Katja Pokrovskaja Tamm, Janne Lehtiö, Rozbeh Jafari
pmc-13669360.description: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) exhibits molecular and metabolic heterogeneity that limits therapeutic efficacy. Although antimetabolites remain central to ALL treatment, determinants of therapeutic sensitivity and resistance remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigated the activity and molecular response landscape of the purine analog triciribine (TCN) across diverse ALL models using integrated phosphoproteomics, thermal proteome profiling, and quantitative proteomics.

uslaw-usc-t38-s531.description: United States Code, Title 38 (Veterans’ Benefits); Part I (General Provisions); Chapter 5 (Authority And Duties Of The Secretary); Subchapter II (Specified Functions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Naming Limitation.— Except as expressly provided by law or as authorized under subsection (b), a facility, structure, or real property of the Department, and a major portion (such as a wing or floor).
